_aviso: GUION ESCRITO A MANO: mutantes reconstruidos por mí a partir de las descripciones de los sobrevivientes de la corrida real (iteración 2). NO es salida de un LLM.

mutants.description: FirstPairOnly: merges only the first adjacent equal pair
SortAscendingMerge: sorts the non-zero tiles ascending, then merges adjacent equals once
SortDescendingMerge: sorts the non-zero tiles descending, then merges adjacent equals once
MergeByValue: merges all tiles of the same value into one tile (value * count)
RepeatedMerge: keeps merging adjacent equal tiles until none remain
MergeCompatible: merges adjacent tiles if equal or one is double the other (sum)
